sp500_rationale: SpaceX post-IPO momentum, improving consumer sentiment (48.9 vs 44.8 prior low), and falling oil prices on Iran deal optimism are bullish tailwinds. Key risk: Iran deal collapse over the weekend would reverse energy gains and pressure broad equities.

stock_pick_rationales.MRVL: Marvell Technology joins S&P 500 on June 22 — index fund forced-buy deadline creates mechanical demand; AI chip exposure adds fundamental support.
stock_pick_rationales.DAL: Delta Air Lines has highest leverage to oil costs in consumer-facing sectors; Iran deal / Hormuz reopening = sharp jet fuel cost drop = major margin expansion.
stock_pick_rationales.FLEX: Flex Ltd also joins S&P 500 on June 22 alongside MRVL — same forced-buy catalyst, less covered and possibly more efficiently priced opportunity.
stock_pick_rationales.WBD: Warner Bros. Discovery up 2.4% today with Communication Services as 3rd-best sector; streaming and CTV ad spend recovery is a structural tailwind.
stock_pick_rationales.SPCX: SpaceX closed first IPO day at $161 (+19%) with strong institutional demand signal. If it holds above $155 on Monday open, momentum likely continues into the week.
